retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for creating high-contrast group portraits framed by glowing geometric light trails and integrated monolinear neon-style typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, low-key group portrait set within a receding tunnel of glowing white neon tubes, topped with a large, monolinear script logo that appears to be made of light.
coreVisualRelationships: Glowing neon tubes create a radial perspective leading toward the subjects
High-contrast lighting illuminates only the faces of the subjects against a black background
The primary logo overlaps the top of the tunnel structure
Secondary text is small, sans-serif, and aligned to the right margin
coreInvariants: Monolinear stroke weight for the main script
Radial symmetry in the background light trails
Deep black shadows with no visible background detail

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a diamond formation, centered vertically and horizontally in the lower two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, glowing script logo at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the neon tubes inward toward the faces, then upward to the glowing logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the lower half and between light tubes.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for neon tubes and typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and subtle amber highlights on faces
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between pure black and glowing white; low saturation overall.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Monolinear cursive script with extended horizontal terminals
letterConstructionRules: Horizontal bars that extend across the width of the composition
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letter features a long horizontal tail extending to the left
Final letter features a long horizontal tail extending to the right

composition.position: top right, below main logo tail

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large, expressive monolinear script paired with a tiny, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule lines extending from typography

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the monolinear, glowing aesthetic of the primary logo
Matches the wide-tracked, geometric feel of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key photograph of four men's faces in a diamond arrangement, illuminated by a tunnel of glowing white neon tubes that recede into a black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white monolinear script logo at the top center with a soft outer glow, and a small all-caps sans-serif subtitle aligned to the right below the logo's horizontal extension.

verificationChecks: Do the neon tubes create a radial perspective?
Is the main typography monolinear with a glow?
Are the faces high-contrast with deep shadows?

mustRedesign: Exact letterforms of the source text
postGenerationChecks: Check for monolinear stroke consistency in the logo
Ensure the glow effect does not obscure the letterforms
Verify the radial alignment of the background tubes
Confirm the subjects are only partially lit
Check that the secondary text is legible but small
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key portrait + radial neon tunnel + monolinear script overlay
